valvetrain.summary: The crank turns the cam at half speed. Each lobe raises a lifter and pushrod, rotating a rocker to open its valve. The spring closes the valve as the lobe falls.
valvetrain.limits: Valve and pushrod lengths follow replacement catalogs; intake and exhaust spring heights follow service load-test dimensions. The smooth cam profile, rocker shape, spring winding and absolute mounting heights remain illustrative, and the parts installed in this truck have not been identified.

steps.title: Follow one cylinder
steps.text: Isolate a complete cylinder valve train to see its intake and exhaust valves together with their lifters, pushrods and rockers. Scrub the 720-degree crank control to follow the cycle.

steps.title: Inspect the cam
steps.text: The cam turns once per two crank revolutions. Separate intake and exhaust lobes repeat the cycle in firing order 1–5–3–6–2–4.

valvetrain-cylinder-1.summary: Cylinder 1: the intake valve admits mixture and the exhaust valve releases burned gas. Both mechanisms share the crank-cycle control.
valvetrain-cylinder-1.limits: Valve and pushrod lengths follow replacement catalogs; intake and exhaust spring heights follow service load-test dimensions. The smooth cam profile, rocker shape, spring winding and absolute mounting heights remain illustrative, and the parts installed in this truck have not been identified.

steps.title: Lifter to valve
steps.text: The pushrod follows a solved rigid linkage. Its cup and rocker contact are modeled; hydraulic lash adjustment is not simulated.

steps.title: Intake valve
steps.text: The rocker opens the valve against its spring. This cam curve is an illustrative replacement-catalog study.

steps.title: Exhaust valve
steps.text: The exhaust follows a different phase of the same 720-degree cycle.
